assumptions.text: Held-running state and its cost are ASSUMED. The planner may now keep a machine running through a bucket WITHOUT moving material, instead of commanding a token parcel to bridge the gap. This was added because the audited S0 week carried five 1 t bridge buckets in the middle of otherwise substantial campaigns, and banning one merely moved the trick elsewhere (5 to 19 below-floor parcels): the model had no truthful way to express 'stay on, move nothing'. EQUIPMENT_HOLD_BUCKET_PENALTY = 8 is bounded by argument, not by measurement: it must be below a stop plus a later start (10 + 20) or holding would never be chosen, and above zero or the planner would hold everywhere for free. Held minutes are reported separately from active minutes and are never presented as production. Whether these plants actually prefer an idling drive to a stop/restart, and at what energy and wear cost, is unknown.

assumptions.text: Campaign / parcel / minimum-run policy is an ASSUMED demonstration smoothing rule, NOT a plant-approved operating limit. Without it the hourly activity constraint degenerates to one physical tonne for any machine whose rate_min_tph is zero — every stacker here — so the planner could pad a campaign with meaningless 1 t hours at no cost, and the minute overlay drew each as a 1-minute run. The installed defaults are a 250 t preferred parcel per bucket, a 20-minute minimum run, a 30-minute maximum held (running, empty-belt) gap and no dwell constraint (1 bucket). Other presets allow and price an explicit below-floor exception. The operator-default blending showcase keeps the 250 t preference soft. Optional bounded parcel consolidation is disabled by default. Residuals may wait only in the existing modelled buffers and are batched without changing route/grade totals, receiving-unit service, terminal inventories or worsening the original objective. Process targets derived from forecasts may report shortfalls; explicit operator commitments stay hard. Minute executability and actual cycling/cost checks gate every accepted secondary candidate. A necessary small job remains feasible and visible.

assumptions.text: Continuous-feed service share is an ASSUMED demonstration test, not an approved minimum stable feed rate.
